'''Feras''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] he resided at the [[Incorporation Spaceport]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he asked an Imperial to meet with [[Darth Charnus]].
